error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If only 4 is taken out, the issue is missing the shared x factor. Quadratic common-factor work depends on recognising both numerical and variable factors.

hint_ladder.title: Shared factor
hint_ladder.prompt: Both terms share 4x, not just 4. Look for the number factor and the x factor.

hint_ladder.title: Missing x factor
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is taking out only 4 and leaving an extra x pattern harder than necessary.

hint_ladder.title: Quadratic factor routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Find the greatest shared number and variable factor, divide each term, then check by expanding. Apply it here; do not copy.

expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on identifying 4x as the full common factor and dividing both terms by it.
